topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I walked past the spot where I once planted a sapling, a little stick of hope with soil-crusted hands. Years have turned that young tree into a towering giant, its branches reaching wide like arms ready to embrace the sky. Today, all that remains is a stump, silent and forlorn, a heartbeat carved into wood. I can't help but feel a void, a piece of my childhood chipped away. Yet, here I stand, not in despair but with a resolve. This stump is not the end but a new beginning. I’ll plant another, maybe two, and watch them grow, stronger and more resilient. Each leaf a testament to the cycles of life and the unyielding spirit of renewal.
